 How Stephen Curry inspired Ayesha Curry in Christmas rom-com role that has everybody talking about kissing scene
 Andrew Korpan, ClutchPoints Wed, November 11, 2026 at 7:20 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kirby Lee-Imagn Images. How Stephen Curry inspired Ayesha Curry in Christmas rom-com role that has everybody talking about kissing scene appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . 
 Everybody has been buzzing about Stephen Curry 's wife Ayesha, who starred in a new rom-com movie, Second Chance Holiday, that featured a kissing scene.
 While that may be awkward for some married couples, the Golden State Warriors star guard was extremely supportive as she detailed on the TODAY show (via the New York Post).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She drew "inspiration" from her husband, who is extremely "superstitious." He has a routine that he follows strictly, and his wife "drew some inspiration for my character from him."
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 Curry's Second Chance Holiday is streaming now on The Roku Channel. It was released on Thursday, Nov. 5, and also stars Matthew Daddario.
 This is not her first acting rodeo, though. Curry previously starred in Irish Wish, Joy to the World, and Charming. Her husband produced and voiced a character in the 2026 animated movie GOAT .
 Stephen Curry and the Warriors are currently 8-3 and in second place in the Pacific Division. They are red-hot on an eight-game winning streak since starting the season 0-3. Their next game will be against Kevin Durant and the Houston Rockets on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 Advertisement Advertisement Currently, Curry is second in the NBA in points per game. He averages 30.6 points per game and has scored more than 30 points in four of the nine games he has played so far.
 The Warriors have won four championships with Curry, and they are hoping to reach the mountaintop again. They added Yaxel Lendeborg in the NBA Draft this year, who averages 21.4 points per game. He leads the Warriors with 7.2 rebounds per game.
 Click Above to Subscribe Curry, 38, is a two-time NBA MVP and 12-time All-Star. He has also won the Three-Point Contest twice. His career is probably winding down, but he leaves a legendary legacy behind. He is the NBA's all-time leader in three-pointers.
